narrativeVibe: Space opera — a sense of frontier wonder, tension and danger across the stars.
scenario: You crew a small starship on the edge of charted space. Derelict signals, alien artifacts and uneasy alliances wait out there, and every jump could be your last — or your fortune.
start: Your ship docks at Kessler Station, docking bay 7. Rumors drift through the crowd: a derelict freighter near Vexar's moon, cargo worth a fortune — or a trap. {{user}}, what do you do?
imageStyleTags: (masterpiece:1.2), cinematic, sci-fi concept art, dramatic lighting, ((sci-fi)), high detail
imageNegativeTags: low quality, fused digits, bad anatomy, watermark, text

defs.label: Physique
defs.hint: Brawn and hardiness — lifting, grappling, surviving harsh environments
defs.rules: Brawn and hardiness. Used for lifting, grappling, hand-to-hand combat and surviving harsh or low-gravity environments.

defs.label: Agility
defs.hint: Reflexes and coordination — dodging, climbing, zero-G movement
defs.rules: Reflexes, balance and coordination. Used for dodging, acrobatics, climbing and moving in zero gravity or tight spaces.

defs.label: Perception
defs.hint: Awareness — spotting threats, scanning, reading instruments
defs.rules: Awareness and attention to detail. Used to spot threats and ambushes, scan for anomalies and read sensor readouts.

defs.label: Intellect
defs.hint: Knowledge and logic — science, research, analysis
defs.rules: Knowledge, logic and analysis. Used for science, research, puzzles, code-breaking and understanding alien technology or customs.

defs.label: Piloting
defs.hint: Flying and driving — ships, shuttles, vehicles
defs.rules: Skill at flying and driving. Used to pilot starships, shuttles and ground vehicles, and to pull off maneuvers or evade pursuit.

defs.label: Engineering
defs.hint: Tech and machinery — repairing, building, sabotaging
defs.rules: Technical skill with machinery. Used to repair and maintain ships and equipment, build gadgets and sabotage enemy tech.

defs.label: Medicine
defs.hint: Healing and biology — treating wounds, disease, xenobiology
defs.rules: Medical and biological knowledge. Used to treat injuries and illness, perform surgery and understand alien biology.

defs.label: Social
defs.hint: Presence and diplomacy — negotiation, persuasion, command
defs.rules: Presence and diplomatic skill. Used for negotiation, persuasion, intimidation, commanding crews and dealing with alien cultures.

defs.label: Psionics
defs.rules: Psychic power. Used for telepathy, telekinesis, precognition and sensing minds. Powerful but rare and draining.

defs.label: Luck
defs.hint: Fortune — wild chances, favorable coincidences and narrow escapes
defs.rules: Fortune and fate. Used to nudge uncertain outcomes, find favorable coincidences and slip through narrow escapes.

trackers.rules: Where the hero currently is — station, planet, ship or region. Short and specific, e.g. "Kessler Station — docking bay 7", "Vexar, desert moon". Update whenever the scene moves.

trackers.label: Quest
trackers.rules: The hero's single current active mission, one short phrase — e.g. "Smuggle the crates past the blockade". Only ONE at a time: when complete or abandoned, replace it, or leave empty.

trackers.label: Lvl
trackers.rules: The hero's level. Grant a level-up when exp is full.

trackers.label: Exp
trackers.rules: Experience toward the next level. Award exp for completed missions, discoveries and victories. When exp fills to its max of 100 the hero levels up and exp resets to 0.

trackers.label: HP
trackers.rules: Hit points — the hero's health. Damage reduces it; medical care or rest restores it. If it reaches 0 the hero is downed or in peril. Max derives from Physique.

trackers.label: Credits
trackers.rules: The hero's money in credits. Track purchases, bounties and bribes here.

trackers.label: Fuel
trackers.rules: The ship's fuel, 0-100. Long jumps and maneuvers spend it; refueling at stations restores it. At 0 the ship is stranded.

trackers.label: Hull
trackers.rules: The ship's hull integrity, 0-100. Combat and hazards damage it; repairs restore it. At 0 the hull is breached.

trackers.label: Oxygen
trackers.rules: Life support / oxygen reserves, 0-100. Consumed over time on derelicts and barren worlds; depleted = suffocation risk.

trackers.label: Psi
trackers.rules: Psionic energy for using psychic powers. Using powers spends it; rest restores it to its max. Max derives from Psionics.
